not_verified_on_staging: This lane adds one read-only GitHub Actions workflow (GATE-INVARIANTS.yml) and its static test. No gateway, frontend or database code changes, so a staging deploy runs no new code path. The workflow runs in GitHub Actions on push to main and daily; it is proven by its first run on main (run URL in commands.log) and by scripts/ci/workflow-trigger-check.test.mjs.
